## Start here

This small site records how projects changed from an initial idea to tested evidence. Replace this sample text. Do not publish your student number, schedule, private contact details, classroom codes, passwords, tokens, or identifiable information about other students.

::: {.callout-note title="Current focus"}
Add one project to the [project collection](projects/index.qmd), then verify the calculations, links, images, and privacy checklist before sharing.
:::

## What a project entry shows

- the engineering problem and success criteria;
- an initial design or prediction;
- calculations, schematics, code, simulation, or measurements;
- mistakes, revisions, and final conclusions;
- what the student learned and how the evidence was checked.
